blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A new mobile application developed by information technology students from Mindoro State University (MinSU) is poised to make transactions and information access easier for member-consumer-owners of the Oriental Mindoro Electric Cooperative, Inc. (ORMECO). Developed by third-year students Marc Jimbell M. Cabatay, Monica C. Bacay, and Neil M. Arguelles, who are completing their Bachelor of Science in IT course, the capstone project is designed to streamline ORMECO clients’ access to vital cooperative information and services. The system features include QR code-based member access, billing estimation, and a facility to report service concerns directly through the mobile platform. […]...
